connect-CC.prompt: Read ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/connect-CC.md for full instructions. Then execute the user's request using Chrome CDP on port 9223. Find each bank's authenticated tab by domain, navigate to the relevant section, and download/extract the requested data. Never close the browser. Never open files in Edge. Save all output to the configured directories and report results.
connect-CC.inputPrompt: What do you want to do? (e.g., 'download 2025 tax documents from all banks', 'pull transactions from Capital One')
connect-CC.description: Connect to CC/bank portals via Chrome CDP to download tax docs, transactions, and account data

personal-VM.prompt: Read ${LOCAL_SKILLS}/personal-vm.md for full instructions. Then execute the user's request. CRITICAL: always switch to subscription dccd7bf2-f1a6-4514-874c-812f0e2b19ec before any az CLI operation, and switch back to MSFT-Provisioning-01[Prod] after. For SSH, use key ~/.ssh/id_rsa_jpn0001 with -o PreferredAuthentications=publickey. Report results clearly.
personal-VM.inputPrompt: What do you want to do? (e.g., 'start JPN0001', 'check disk space', 'how much have I spent this month')
personal-VM.description: Manage personal Azure VMs -- start, stop, SSH, expand disk, query costs, run remote commands
